name: Eczema
overview: Scripture acknowledges physical afflictions such as scurvy and scabbed conditions, which can be related to ailments like eczema, as seen in Leviticus 21:20 and 22:22 where blemishes affect priestly service. God's promise of healing and protection from disease is affirmed in Exodus 15:26, emphasizing obedience to His commandments as the path to health. The ministry of Jesus, who healed many with various physical maladies (Matthew 15:30), demonstrates God's compassionate power to restore. The story of Job (Job 42:10) further reveals God's sovereign ability to bring restoration and blessing after suffering.
